# n-listbox

> Listbox component with single or multiple selection and keyboard navigation.

**Class:** `NListbox`

**ARIA role:** `listbox`
**Internal controllers:** `ListNavigateController`, `DataListController`

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|---------|-------------|
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  | Disables interaction |
| `multiple` | `boolean` |  | Enables multi-select mode |
| `virtual-focus` | `boolean` |  | Uses active attribute instead of roving tabindex (for combobox) |

## CSS Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Values | Description |
|-----------|------|--------|-------------|
| `active` | boolean | _(boolean)_ | Highlights the currently focused option via virtual focus (set by keyboard navigation) |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
|-------|--------|-------------|
| `native:change` | _(none)_ | Fired when selection changes with `{ value, label }` detail |

## Accessibility

- **Role:** `listbox`

### Keyboard

| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| `ArrowDown` | Moves active highlight to the next option |
| `ArrowUp` | Moves active highlight to the previous option |
| `Home` | Moves active highlight to the first option |
| `End` | Moves active highlight to the last option |
| `Enter` | Selects the active option |
| `Space` | Selects the active option |

## Behavior

- **native:select on n-option** → Selects or toggles option in single/multiple mode, dispatches native:change
- **disabled attribute change** → Updates aria-disabled state

## Composition

### Children
- `<n-option>`
- `<n-option-group>`

### Parents
- `<n-select>`
- `<n-combobox>`

## Compatible Traits

`hover`, `focus-visible`, `list-navigate`

## Usage

### Minimal

```html
<n-listbox></n-listbox>
```

### Examples

```html
<n-listbox id="basic-listbox" variant="secondary">
            <n-option value="apple">Apple</n-option>
            <n-option value="banana">Banana</n-option>
            <n-option value="cherry">Cherry</n-option>
            <n-option value="date">Date</n-option>
            <n-option value="elderberry">Elderberry</n-option>
          </n-listbox>
```

```html
<n-listbox variant="secondary">
            <n-option value="a">Available</n-option>
            <n-option value="b" disabled>Disabled</n-option>
            <n-option value="c">Available</n-option>
            <n-option value="d" disabled>Disabled</n-option>
            <n-option value="e">Available</n-option>
          </n-listbox>
```

```html
<n-listbox id="preselected-listbox" variant="secondary">
            <n-option value="small">Small</n-option>
            <n-option value="medium">Medium</n-option>
            <n-option value="large">Large</n-option>
          </n-listbox>
```
